Sandbox_GunWorks_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch. Off = vanilla firearm combat.
Sandbox_GunWorks_UseInIsoView_tooltip: Also use projectiles without Viewpoint, aimed along vanilla's aim.
Sandbox_GunWorks_VelocityScale_tooltip: Multiplies all muzzle velocities. At 1.0 (real values) drop is nearly invisible at Project Zomboid distances. 0.4 gives about 10 cm of drop at 50 m for a rifle and 15 cm at 25 m for a pistol.
Sandbox_GunWorks_DragScale_tooltip: Multiplier on the per-calibre air drag.
Sandbox_GunWorks_DamageFalloff_tooltip: 0 = full vanilla damage at any range. 1 = damage scales with the round's remaining kinetic energy.
Sandbox_GunWorks_ProjectileLifetime_tool: Rounds are removed after this time.
Sandbox_GunWorks_MaxDistanceMultiplier_t: How far rounds fly, as a multiple of the weapon's range (pistol 15 -> 45 m at 3.0).
Sandbox_GunWorks_ZeroDistance_tooltip: Distance where rounds cross the reticle again. 0 = bore aimed at the reticle point.
Sandbox_GunWorks_SpreadScale_tooltip: Multiplier on dispersion from accuracy, skill, movement, moodles and weapon condition.
Sandbox_GunWorks_Penetration_tooltip: Rifle rounds with enough energy can pass through one body (full-power rifles two).
Sandbox_GunWorks_HitLocations_tooltip: The body part the round physically hit goes into vanilla's head/torso/limb damage, and a shot player is wounded on exactly that part (hands and feet included). Off = vanilla's random part.
Sandbox_GunWorks_FurnitureCollision_tool: Solid furniture (up to 1.9 m) and counters/tables (up to 0.9 m) stop rounds.
Sandbox_GunWorks_ServerValidation_toolti: Server-side line-of-fire and damage checks for firearm hits.
Sandbox_GunWorks_OverflowDamage_tooltip: A body part's health stops at 0, so in vanilla more rounds into an emptied part do no damage. On = the damage the part cannot take still comes off the overall health (bullet wounds only).
Sandbox_GunWorks_HeadDamageShare_tooltip: How much of a head wound counts against the overall health. Vanilla is 0.6 (less than the neck's 0.7). 1.0 = a head wound counts in full.
Sandbox_GunWorks_DebugLog_tooltip: Writes every shot, wound (body part, damage, overflow, health before and after) and hit packet to console.txt / server-console.txt. Turn off on a busy server.
Sandbox_GunWorks_Gunplay_tooltip: Sway, recoil and steady aim follow the Aiming and Fitness values below. Off: sway x1, recoil x1, breath 5 s / refill 6 s for everyone.
Sandbox_GunWorks_SwayAimingL0_tooltip: Sway multiplier at Aiming level 0. ADS's own value is 1.35. Levels in between are interpolated.
Sandbox_GunWorks_SwayAimingL10_tooltip: Sway multiplier at Aiming level 10. ADS's own value is 0.70.
Sandbox_GunWorks_RecoilAimingL0_tooltip: Recoil multiplier at Aiming level 0 (1.0 = ADS's recoil).
Sandbox_GunWorks_RecoilAimingL10_tooltip: Recoil multiplier at Aiming level 10 (1.0 = ADS's recoil).
Sandbox_GunWorks_RecoilRampMax_tooltip: Sideways recoil grows over a held burst up to this multiplier. 1.0 = no growth.
Sandbox_GunWorks_RecoilRampTime_tooltip: Seconds of continuous fire until the sideways recoil reaches its maximum.
Sandbox_GunWorks_SteadyCutL0_tooltip: Share of the sway removed while holding breath at Aiming level 0. ADS: 0.88.
Sandbox_GunWorks_SteadyCutL10_tooltip: Share of the sway removed while holding breath at Aiming level 10. ADS: 0.88.
Sandbox_GunWorks_SteadyHoldBase_tooltip: Seconds of breath hold at Fitness 0. ADS: 5.
Sandbox_GunWorks_SteadyHoldPerFitness_to: Extra seconds of breath hold per Fitness level.
Sandbox_GunWorks_SteadyRefillBase_toolti: Seconds to refill the breath at Fitness 0. ADS: 6.
Sandbox_GunWorks_SteadyRefillPerFitness_: Seconds taken off the refill per Fitness level.
Sandbox_GunWorks_AdsSpreadScale_tooltip: Random dispersion added on top of the sight line while aiming down the sights. 0 = the bullet goes exactly where the sight points (sway and recoil decide).
Sandbox_GunWorks_AdsInertia_tooltip: The gun lags behind when you turn quickly while aiming.
Sandbox_GunWorks_AdsRaiseSpeed_tooltip: Multiplies how fast every weapon brings its sights up (higher = faster).
Sandbox_GunWorks_AdsRest_tooltip: Resting the gun on a surface, going prone or a deployed bipod reduces sway and recoil.
Sandbox_GunWorks_AdsHideCrosshair_toolti: Viewpoint's crosshair is hidden while aiming down the sights.
Sandbox_GunWorks_AdsThirdPerson_tooltip: Raising the sights in third person switches to first person.
Sandbox_GunWorks_AdsEyeBox_tooltip: Scopes show a lens shadow when the eye is not lined up.
Sandbox_GunWorks_AdsSteadyZoom_tooltip: Zoom of iron sights and red dots while holding breath. 1.0 = no zoom.
Sandbox_GunWorks_AdsScopeZoom_tooltip: Multiplies the zoom of magnified scopes (1.5 = a 4x scope zooms 6x).
Sandbox_GunWorks_AdsWeaponCollision_tool: Guns give way at walls, doors, furniture and vehicles instead of passing through them.
